title: Quantitative central limit theorem for an integrated periodogram via the fourth moment theorem
summary: We revisit the central limit theorem for integrated periodograms, equivalently for Toeplitz quadratic forms of stationary Gaussian sequences. Under a regular-variation assumption allowing long-memory singularities and slowly varying corrections, we prove a quantitative central limit theorem in 1-Wasserstein distance.
